title: The Mysterious Sumerian King List

scenes.text: The list includes the lengths of reign for each king
The Sumerian King List is one of the oldest and most important sources of information on the history of Mesopotamia
But how did the ancient Sumerians keep track of time with such precision?

description: Explore the mysteries of the Sumerian King List, one of the oldest and most important sources of information on the history of Mesopotamia. How did the ancient Sumerians keep track of time with such precision? Follow us for more mysteries of the ancient world
